body.title: Branded Looker Studio dashboard for a public-sector campaign
body.aiReason: Qualified – dashboard/visualization focus aligns with my data viz skills (PowerBI/Tableau) and the detailed, legitimate client request shows a real opportunity.
body.description:
•	Connect and blend the sources.
•	Reporting years run 7 Oct to 6 Oct, not calendar years, so period comparisons need to follow that.
•	About seven pages: an overview, one per campaign topic, and a data-status page.
•	Filters by topic, data owner, status and reporting year.
•	Sharing restricted to named viewers.
Design
It needs to be visually simple and follow the campaign's brand, since a generic Looker Studio template won't work for us. We share the brand guidelines, logos, illustrations and a page mockup once you're hired. No red/green performance coding, and WCAG 2.1 AA contrast throughout.
Milestones
1.	One fully designed page on sample data, for our approval
2.	Full build with live data
3.	Handoff: a short maintenance guide, a recorded walkthrough, and written steps for transferring the report to another Google account
You have: a portfolio of custom-designed Looker Studio dashboards, experience with blended data and GA4, and experience bringing non-native sources into Looker Studio. Public-sector work is a plus.
Terms: work for hire, all rights assigned to us, NDA, no reuse of the design or data.
